signals.brief_en:
Title: Show HN: Panel – A research workspace where the agent can build its own panes
Summary: A new open‑source tool, Panel, enables AI agents to dynamically create and arrange custom interface panes for research tasks. It integrates with existing LLM APIs, supports multi‑modal inputs, and allows agents to persistently store context across panes. Early adopters report faster data aggregation and more flexible workflow design, though performance depends on underlying model capabilities and API latency. The project is hosted on GitHub under an MIT license; community contributions are encouraged.

signals.title: murzirius/VPS-Guardian-MCP
signals.content: Secure MCP server that gives AI agents structured, audited access to Linux VPS: monitoring, Docker and Compose management, config changes, security checks, and safe recovery over SSH.
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance. Final score: 58. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: murzirius/VPS-Guardian-MCP

Brief: VPS-Guardian-MCP is a managed control plane (MCP) server that provides AI agents with structured, auditable access to Linux virtual private servers (VPS). Through SSH it enables real‑time monitoring, Docker and Docker‑Compose orchestration, configuration management, automated security checks, and controlled recovery actions. The system logs all commands and state changes, allowing verification of agent behavior and rollback if needed. It is positioned as an OSINT‑compatible tool for secure, transparent automation of VPS operations, with explicit limits on privilege escalation and clear uncertainty about long‑term resilience against novel threats.

العنوان: murzirius/VPS-Guardian-MCP

الملخص: VPS-Guardian-MCP هو خادم لوحة تحكم مُدارة (MCP) يوفّر للوكلاء الذكائيين وصولًا منظمًا ومُدققًا إلى خوادم VPS لينكس. عبر SSH يتيح مراقبة فورية، وإدارة حاويات Docker وDocker‑Compose، وتعديل التكوين، وإجراء فحوصات أمان آلية، وإجراءات استعادة آمنة. يسجّل النظام جميع الأوامر وتغييرات الحالة، ما يسمح بالتحقق من سلوك الوكيل والعودة إلى الحالة السابقة إذا لزم الأمر. يُصنّف كأداة متوافقة مع OSINT لتأمين أتمتة شفافة لعمليات VPS، مع حدود واضحة لتصعيد الصلاحيات وإبقاء بعض الشكوك حول القدرة على الصمود أمام تهديدات مستقبلية غير معروفة.

signals.brief_en: DARPA reports that roughly 75% of pre‑hospital combat casualty care goes undocumented, leaving trained warfighters as the sole providers in most cases. To close this critical data gap, DARPA has launched the Documentation and Decision Support (D2) Sprint, aimed at capturing field medical actions and delivering real‑time decision assistance to improve outcomes.

The affected material was removed and the vendor says credentials were rotated; rotation could not be independently verified. No secret values are reproduced here.

signals.brief_en: Security researcher disclosed that a Saudi government‑issued mobile app, installed on over 10 million devices, inadvertently included a private key and API credentials belonging to Saudi National Bank. The compromised components have been removed from the app, and the vendor claims the credentials have been rotated, though independent verification of the rotation is unavailable. No secret values are reproduced.
signals.brief_ar: أفاد باحث أمان أن تطبيقًا حكوميًا سعوديًا، تم تحميله على أكثر من 10 ملايين جهاز، تضمن بطريق الخطأ مفتاحًا خاصًا وبيانات اعتماد API تابعة للبنك الوطني السعودي. تم إزالة المكوّنات المتأثرة من التطبيق، وتزعم الجهة المورِّدة أن البيانات تم تدويرها، إلا أن التدوير لم يُتحقق منه بصورة مستقلة. لا يتم إعادة إنتاج أي قيم سرية.
